Lightning risk map (tap to open / close) Conditional on detected lightning. This is not overall wildfire risk.
Each square = a 0.1° cell (about 11 km) with lightning in the last 24 h. Colour = chance that a reported lightning-caused fire follows in the 3x3 cells around it within the next 3 days. It is not the chance of any wildfire, human-caused fires, or a guarantee. Hover a square for its inputs.
under 0.5% (real about 0.6% or less)
0.5 - 0.9% (real about 1%)
0.9 - 1.6% (real 1 - 2%)
1.6 - 3.5% (real 2 - 4%)
3.5 - 8% (real 4 - 8%)
8 - 23% (real 8 - 16%)
over 23% (real 16%+)
Covers Canadian land up to 66°N. Lightning north of 66°N and outside Canada is not scored. Dashed outline = Yukon/NT/Nunavut (less certain; the model was tested there with fewer fires). Tested 2023-24: in the North, Saskatchewan and Yukon the shown % runs about 1.4-1.9x too high; in October it runs too low. Treat those as rough.
